title: An analysis method and corresponding defense method for federated learning backdoor attacks

pse.problem: Significant reduction in model accuracy when federal learning system encounters data heterogeneity.
pse.solution_function: Analyzes federal learning back door attacks by selecting partial data for processing according to a backdoor type, generating backdoor data, initializing a local model, and calculating a regular term about the characteristic similarity based on the output of the feature extractor of the local model and an average value.
pse.solution_structure: Client with a local model that includes a feature extractor and server side with a global model.
pse.solution_implementation: Client selects partial data, generates backdoor data, initializes local model, replaces certain proportion of batch data with back door data, inputs normal data into feature extractor to output average value, replaces data in batch with back door data, calculates regular term about characteristic similarity.
pse.effect: Improved defense capability of federal learning on attacks of partial virus injection of a feature extractor of a model.
